5354.title: Runtime replacement loses ownership under overlapping requests
5354.rootCauseOneLine: Runtime replacement removes the resident entry before shutdown completes, allowing overlapping ensures to create replacements and overwrite a still-live runtime.
5354.proposedFix: Serialize complete environment ensures using an environment-keyed in-flight promise, preserving shared provisioning cancellation and rechecking compatibility afterward.
5354.caveats: The runtime ownership race is reproduced twice on trusted main; live provider double turns and reported downstream side effects were not recreated. Reproduction code and exact output are inline, following report-repository artifact policy.
